label: H.R. 10325
title: To increase the mandatory contribution amount of Federal Home Loan Banks to the Affordable Housing Program, and for other purposes.

items.item: Federal Home Loan Banks to the Affordable Housing Program
items.snippet: This bill increases the required contributions of Federal Home Loan Banks to the Affordable Housing Program established by each bank.
These programs subsidize interest rates for member banks to finance (1) mortgages for low- and moderate-income individuals;
and (2) the purchase, construction, or rehabilitation of affordable rental housing.
